rules.name: cs-16-client-settings-legacy-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT b.client_code, count(*) AS booking_rows, count(DISTINCT b.contract_number) AS contracts, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.n > 1 THEN b.contract_number END) AS contracts_with_several_booking_rows, sum(CASE WHEN b.sub_account IS NOT NULL AND b.sub_account <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_with_sub_account, count(DISTINCT b.structure_name) AS structures, max(b.structure_name) AS a_structure, sum(CASE WHEN b.daily_or_eod = 'DAILY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daily_rows, sum(CASE WHEN b.daily_or_eod = 'EOD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eod_rows, sum(CASE WHEN b.structure_name IS NULL OR b.structure_name = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_without_structure, min(b.trade_date) AS first_trade_date, max(b.trade_date) AS last_trade_date FROM dbsystemuat.client_statement_booking_order_information_table_cfs b JOIN (SELECT contract_number, count(*) AS n FROM dbsystemuat.client_statement_booking_order_information_table_cfs GROUP BY contract_number) m ON m.contract_number = b.contract_number GROUP BY b.client_code
SELECT client_code, structure_name, daily_or_eod, count(*) AS booking_rows FROM dbsystemuat.client_statement_booking_order_information_table_cfs GROUP BY client_code, structure_name, daily_or_eod

SELECT d.counterparty_parent, count(*) AS trades, count(DISTINCT d.contract_number) AS contracts, sum(CASE WHEN d.contract_number REGEXP '[ABC]$' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trades_on_suffixed_contracts, count(DISTINCT d.instrument) AS instruments, max(d.trade_source) AS a_trade_source, count(DISTINCT d.trade_source) AS trade_sources, count(DISTINCT d.subportfolio) AS subportfolios, max(d.subportfolio) AS a_subportfolio FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs d WHERE d.subportfolio LIKE 'RMS%' AND d.transaction_date < '2026-11-06' GROUP BY d.counterparty_parent
